metadata.title: Domestic Intimacy and Generational Care
useCases: Social media campaign for family wellness

recipe.visualDefinition: A candid, medium-shot photograph capturing three generations of a Black family in a sunlit living room. A woman sits on a sofa braiding the hair of a young man sitting on the floor between her legs, while a toddler plays in the foreground. The scene is characterized by warm, earthy tones and the soft texture of analog film.
coreVisualRelationships: The vertical alignment of the woman and man creates a central pillar of care.
The toddler in the foreground provides a sense of depth and future legacy.
The brick fireplace and wooden bookshelf ground the scene in a lived-in, domestic environment.
coreInvariants: Soft, diffused natural light from a side window.
Visible film grain and slight color shifts typical of 35mm stock.
A palette of muted greens, warm browns, and off-whites.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The woman and man occupy the center-left midground; the toddler is in the bottom-right foreground at a smaller scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The woman's hands and the orange comb at the center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the woman's face, follows her arms down to the man's head, then slides down his body to the toddler playing on the rug.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant featuring the brick fireplace provides textural breathing room.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm neutrals (beige, cream, brick red) establish a cozy atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted blue and floral patterns in the rug provide a cool base.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: The bright orange of the comb and colorful toddler toys act as small focal points.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low to medium saturation with a high dynamic range that preserves detail in both shadows and highlights.

graphicDevices: Subtle red date stamp in the bottom margin (film aesthetic)

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution photograph of a sunlit living room with a brick fireplace and a floral rug. A Black woman on a cream sofa is braiding the hair of a Black man sitting on the floor. A Black toddler is playing with wooden toys in the foreground. Use a 35mm film aesthetic with soft grain and natural lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a clean, minimalist sans-serif in a muted white, placed in the negative space of the brick fireplace.

verificationChecks: Ensure the lighting feels natural and directional.
Check for realistic skin tones and hair textures.
Verify the film grain is consistent across the image.

adjustableVariables: Time of day (golden hour vs. midday)
Density of furniture/clutter in the background
mustRedesign: Any modern digital sharpening that breaks the film aesthetic

mustAchieve: Tactile quality in fabrics and surfaces

postGenerationChecks: Does the image convey a sense of quiet intimacy?
Is the film grain texture visible but not distracting?
Are the three subjects clearly defined within the space?
Does the color palette feel cohesive and warm?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine domestic intimacy with 35mm analog aesthetics, focusing on multi-generational care rituals within a warm, sun-drenched interior.
